relations.subject: Bryan J. Cuevas
relations.evidence: I was first introduced to the Tibetan Book of the Dead as a fledgling undergraduate student in an "Oriental" philosophy class at Emory University in 1987.

relations.subject: Bryan J. Cuevas
relations.evidence: The professor of that course, Donald Phillip Verene, had inadvertently sparked within me a fascination with Tibet and Tibetan rituals for the dead and dying
